write_policy: FINDINGS for the rows, MONOTONE for the floors. The census body is written by a red run too — a probe without arms does not make the other rows untrue — and carries `run_ok:false` when it is. `ratchet.*` is this test's OWN baseline and is written as min(previous floor, measured), so no run can raise it; `--accept` raises one deliberately and still exits 1. Before 2026-08-23 the floors lived in the top-level `unarmed` / `directCall`, which a failing run overwrote with its own regression, so the second run was green.
